recorded.how: scripts/server-bench/run.ts, one fresh playground per run, identical counts in all three runs apart from one diff scope in the app profile (14 or 15); measured on the step 5c working tree, whose commit follows 527deb60
recorded.note: Ceilings are measured current cost with headroom, not targets. 5c: a page of history is one `git log` and a continuation two, at any depth, where a page used to cost about 62 and every later page re-walked from the tip. The `history` scenario opens the list and three commits and reads each one's patches, as the document does: 1 page + 3 x (file list + patches) = 7, down from 89 when a page cost one `cat-file` per commit and a commit returned every patch at once. Opening Files is one folder read plus the names quick open searches, and a folder holding an ignored directory costs the same whatever is inside it. A file read remains 0 Git processes, which step 4a's identity-by-stat already gave. Marking is still one request per file; 'mark all' as one request is section 4's to collect.
